official_name: Term Loan Scheme (TLS)
implementing_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Provides concessional term loans to Scheduled Caste individuals/entities for viable income-generating projects up to Rs 15.00 Lakhs.

eligibility_rules.income_definition: Annual family income from all sources
other_conditions: Must belong to Scheduled Caste community
Income must not exceed Rs 3,00,000 p.a.

eligible_activities: Commercially viable projects in any sector

financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: 6% p.a. for loan up to Rs 5.00 Lakhs; 8% p.a. for loan above Rs 5.00 Lakhs up to Rs 15.00 Lakhs to end beneficiary.
financial_parameters.collateral_requirement: As per Channelizing Agency / Bank norm
financial_parameters.guarantee_requirement: Guarantee by SCA or Government where applicable

required_documents: Caste Certificate issued by competent authority
Income Certificate issued by competent authority

application.application_process: Beneficiaries submit project proposal and eligibility documents to State Channelizing Agency (SCA) or participating Bank/RRB/NBFC-MFI.

channel_partners.role: Sanctioning and channelizing agency at state level

verification.verification_notes: Income ceiling limit was made uniform at Rs 3,00,000 p.a. for both rural and urban areas under updated NSFDC guidelines.

official_name: Micro Credit Finance (MCF) Scheme
implementing_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Provides micro-credit financial assistance to SC beneficiaries for small business activities through SHGs or individual mode up to Rs 1.40 Lakhs.

eligibility_rules.income_definition: Annual family income from all sources
other_conditions: Targeted at small micro-entrepreneurs from SC community

financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: 5% p.a. charged to ultimate beneficiary.
financial_parameters.collateral_requirement: Hypothecation of assets created / No collateral for micro loans as per RBI microfinance norms

application.application_process: Apply via SCAs or registered NBFC-MFIs / SHGs linked to NSFDC.

verification.verification_notes: Per unit loan limit updated to Rs 1.40 Lakh.

official_name: Mahila Samriddhi Yojana (MSY)
implementing_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Concessional micro-finance scheme exclusively for Scheduled Caste women entrepreneurs to start small businesses up to Rs 1.40 Lakhs.

eligibility_rules.income_definition: Annual family income from all sources
other_conditions: Exclusively for SC female beneficiaries or SC female SHG members

financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: Highly concessional 4% p.a. charged to target female beneficiary.
financial_parameters.collateral_requirement: Nil for micro-credit as per MFI/SCA standard terms

application.application_process: Submit application form to respective State Channelizing Agency or partner MFI.

verification.verification_notes: Exclusively for SC women with a low interest rate of 4% p.a.

official_name: Educational Loan Scheme (ELS)
implementing_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
implementing_agency: National Scheduled Castes Finance and Development Corporation (NSFDC)
description: Provides concessional educational loans to SC students to pursue professional and technical courses in India and abroad.

eligibility_rules.income_definition: Annual family income from all sources
other_conditions: Must have secured admission in professional/technical course in recognized institution

eligible_activities: Professional degrees (Engineering, Medical, Management, Law, IT, etc.)

financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: 4% p.a. for male students; 3.5% p.a. for female students (0.5% interest rebate).
financial_parameters.collateral_requirement: As per bank / channel partner rules

education_parameters.eligible_courses: Technical and Professional Degree / Diploma courses
education_parameters.eligible_institutions: Recognized Indian Universities / Colleges / Foreign Institutions
education_parameters.course_fee_coverage: Full tuition fee and institutional charges
education_parameters.living_expense_coverage: Hostel fees, books, computer, examination fees

application.application_process: Apply through State Channelizing Agencies or designated Public Sector Banks.

verification.verification_notes: Loan limit: Up to Rs 20.00 Lakhs for studies in India and up to Rs 30.00 Lakhs for studies abroad.

scheme_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes
official_name: Venture Capital Fund for Scheduled Castes (VCF-SC)
implementing_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
implementing_agency: IFCI Venture Capital Development Fund Limited (IFCI Venture)
description: First-of-its-kind venture capital fund to promote entrepreneurship among SCs by providing concessional debt and equity capital.

other_conditions: Entity must have at least 51% shareholding held by SC entrepreneurs for at least 6 months prior to application
Control and management must be with SC promoters

financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: 4% p.a. for female / differently-abled SC entrepreneurs; 8% p.a. for male SC entrepreneurs.
financial_parameters.collateral_requirement: Assets of the company / First charge on project assets

required_documents: Shareholding pattern certificate showing 51%+ SC control

application.application_process: Submit detailed project report and eligibility documents online on VCF-SC portal maintained by IFCI Venture.

channel_partners.partner_type: IFCI Venture Capital Development Fund Limited

verification.verification_notes: Concessional rate of 4% p.a. applies to female and PwD SC entrepreneurs; 8% p.a. for others.

scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Scheduled Castes
official_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Scheduled Castes (CGSSC)
implementing_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
implementing_agency: IFCI Limited
description: Provides credit guarantee coverage to Member Lending Institutions (MLIs) for extending collateral-free loans to SC entrepreneurs.

other_conditions: SC promoter must hold at least 51% holding in borrowing entity
Loan must be sanctioned by an authorized Member Lending Institution (MLI)

eligible_purposes: Bank loan guarantee for business startup

financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: Interest rate is determined by the Member Lending Institution (Bank/FI).
financial_parameters.collateral_requirement: Collateral-free loan (Guarantee provided by IFCI to Bank)
financial_parameters.guarantee_requirement: Guarantee coverage by IFCI to Bank: 100% up to Rs 1 Cr; 80% between Rs 1 Cr and Rs 2 Cr; 70% above Rs 2 Cr up to Rs 5 Cr.

required_documents: Bank loan application form and documents requested by MLI

application.application_process: Borrower applies for a loan at a Member Lending Institution (Bank/FI). The Bank then applies to IFCI for guarantee cover under CGSSC.

channel_partners.partner_type: Public Sector Banks / Private Sector Banks / RRBs / FIs (MLIs)
channel_partners.role: Member Lending Institutions issuing the loan

verification.verification_notes: IMPORTANT: This is a Credit Guarantee Scheme for lenders, NOT a direct loan or subsidy scheme. It enables SC entrepreneurs to obtain collateral-free loans from banks.

official_name: Stand-Up India Scheme
implementing_ministry: Ministry of Finance (Department of Financial Services)
implementing_agency: SIDBI / Scheduled Commercial Banks
description: Facilitates bank loans between Rs 10 Lakhs and Rs 1 Crore to at least one SC/ST borrower and one Woman borrower per bank branch.

other_conditions: Must be a greenfield (first time) venture in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sector
In case of non-individual entities, 51% of shareholding and controlling stake must be held by SC/ST or Woman entrepreneur

financial_parameters.interest_rate_type: Variable / Linked to Bank Base Rate/MCLR
financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: The rate of interest shall be the lowest applicable rate of the bank for that category, not to exceed (Base Rate / MCLR + 3% + Tenor Premium).
financial_parameters.collateral_requirement: Primary security of project assets / Credit Guarantee Scheme (CGFSI) option available
financial_parameters.guarantee_requirement: CGFSI guarantee or collateral as per bank norm

required_documents: Bank Statements & Income Tax Returns (if applicable)

application.application_mode: Online via Stand-Up India Portal or Offline at Bank Branch
application.application_process: Apply directly online via Stand-Up India portal (standupmitra.in) or visit any Scheduled Commercial Bank branch.

channel_partners.partner_type: Scheduled Commercial Banks (PSBs, Private Banks, RRBs)

verification.verification_notes: Mandatory quota of at least 1 SC/ST borrower per bank branch makes this highly accessible across India.

official_name: Pradhan Mantri Dakshta Aur Kushalta Sampann Hitgrahi (PM-DAKSH)
implementing_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
implementing_agency: NSFDC / NBCFDC / NSKFDC
description: Provides free skill training along with monthly stipend and loan linkage assistance to SC youth for employability and self-employment.

eligibility_rules.income_definition: Annual family income from all sources (No income limit for SC artisans/weavers/Safai Karamcharis)
other_conditions: Must belong to targeted SC category

financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: 100% free training provided by Government. Stipend provided directly via DBT.

education_parameters.eligible_courses: NSDC / Sector Skill Council aligned courses
education_parameters.living_expense_coverage: Stipend of Rs 1,000 to Rs 1,500/month provided to trainees during course

application.application_process: Apply online through PM-DAKSH portal or mobile app.

verification.verification_notes: Combines free skill development with direct financial stipend and post-training concessional loan linkage.

scheme_name: Top Class Education Scheme for SC Students
official_name: Central Sector Scheme of Top Class Education for SC Students
implementing_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
implementing_agency: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Provides full financial support to meritorious SC students for pursuing studies in notified premier institutions (IITs, IIMs, AIIMS, NITs, etc.).

eligibility_rules.income_definition: Total family income from all sources
other_conditions: Must have secured admission in notified top premier institutions as per ministry list

eligible_purposes: Higher studies in top notified premier institutions
eligible_activities: Engineering, Medicine, Management, Law, Architecture, Flying, Sciences

financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: Direct financial grant (Non-repayable scholarship/assistance).

education_parameters.eligible_courses: Degree courses in notified top-tier institutes
education_parameters.eligible_institutions: Notified premier institutions (IITs, NITs, IIMs, AIIMS, NLUs, etc.)
education_parameters.course_fee_coverage: Full tuition fee & non-refundable charges (Capped at Rs 2.00 L p.a. for private institutes; actuals for govt institutes)
education_parameters.living_expense_coverage: Rs 3,000/month living allowance + Rs 5,000/year books + Rs 45,000 one-time computer grant

application.application_process: Apply online through National Scholarship Portal (scholarships.gov.in).

verification.verification_notes: Family income ceiling is Rs 8.00 Lakhs per annum. Direct financial grant (not a loan).

scheme_name: National Overseas Scholarship for SC Candidates
official_name: Central Sector Scheme of National Overseas Scholarship for SC Candidates
implementing_ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
implementing_agency: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Provides direct financial assistance to selected SC students for pursuing Master's level courses or Ph.D. abroad.

eligibility_rules.income_definition: Total family income from all sources
other_conditions: Must have unconditional admission offer from foreign university ranking within top 500 (QS/Times)
Age must not be more than 35 years as on 1st April of selection year

eligible_purposes: Master's Degree or Ph.D. studies abroad

financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: Direct non-repayable grant provided by Government.

education_parameters.eligible_institutions: Foreign Universities / Institutions (Ranked within top 500 QS/Times)
education_parameters.living_expense_coverage: USD 15,400 p.a. (USA/Other) / GBP 9,900 p.a. (UK) maintenance + contingency allowance

required_documents: Unconditional Offer Letter from Foreign University

application.application_process: Apply online through NOS portal under Ministry of Social Justice & Empowerment.

channel_partners.partner_type: Department of Social Justice and Empowerment

verification.verification_notes: Age limit capped at 35 years. Income ceiling Rs 8.00 Lakhs p.a. Full grant support.

official_name: Pradhan Mantri Anusuchit Jaati Abhyuday Yojana (PM-AJAY) - Income Generation Sub-Scheme

implementing_agency: State Channelizing Agencies / District Rural Development Agencies

other_conditions: Targeted at small business operators from SC community

eligible_purposes: Small scale trade and commercial activities

financial_parameters.interest_rate_conditions: 6% p.a. charged to target end beneficiary.
financial_parameters.collateral_requirement: Hypothecation of assets / As per SCA terms

application.application_process: Submit application through State Channelizing Agency.

verification.verification_notes: Bridges the gap between micro-credit (up to 1.4 L) and term loan (up to 15 L).

scheme_name: Free Coaching Scheme for SC and OBC Students
official_name: Free Coaching for SCs and OBCs and beneficiaries of PM CARES

SHG/JLG or individual via NBFC-MFI
